posts.name: Legacy102
posts.cooked:
Hey guys! 

I am loving the Sentinels RPG and have already written a campaign to play. My problem, I have no one around me that would like to play. Would anyone be interested in playing the Sentinels RPG here on the forum? We can use the Freedom Five and Unity that are already built. 

The Campaign is a reboot of the sentinels' universe. The writers decide to do an " Ultimate" Universe version of the universe and its characters. This is in order to have it be new reader friendly. 

As a player, you would have creative control of your character. Along with playing your character in the game, you can make up the stories of a comic that can have an effect on the game. They can pull on pre-existing Lore or create some of their own!  For example, the writer(player) of Legacy plays Legacy in the rpg but also once a week "writes" an issue of "Legacy" where more character-driven stuff and world building can happen. 

I will be the editor of this new sentinel comics. I will GM the game and approve the changes and story of the different books to make sure we keep things in the same continuity. 

I would allow characters that are not premaid if we agree on stuff for them together to make them not too strong. 

 

Is this interesting to anyone? Anyone want to be writers of the "Ultimate" Sentinel Comics ??
